scripts.publish:all: cd packages/core && npm publish --access public && cd ../cli && npm publish --access public
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && echo "Uploading to S3..." && aws s3 sync packages/docs/out/ s3://$DOCS_BUCKET --delete && echo "Invalidating CloudFront cache..." && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $CLOUDFRONT_ID --paths "/*"
